messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 - potential cross-tenant routing observed for customer 'Omega Health' (vpc-dedicated). Alerts from routing heuristics flagged >0.1% of requests with tenant prefix mismatch. Pager: paged samira@redwood
Samira (on-call): on it. taking incident lead. brief summary pls — what's the customer impact? @Jun can you join? :eyes:
Jun (SRE): joining. alert shows ~120 anomalous responses in last 10m. sampling indicates response payloads contained partial KV entries referencing tenant 'omega' but coming from pool assigned to tenant 'zeus'. possible routing table bleed or prefix collision in our shared routing table.
Priya (eng-runtime): I see a recent rollout this morning to routing-policy v2.3 that introduced prioritized prefix matching. Reproduced locally: with certain overlapping prefixes, fallback routing can pick wrong pool if the TTL on route entries is stale.
Samira (on-call): immediate customer impact? latency/PII risk?
Jun (SRE): customer reports are 503s? no, they see responses that include other-tenant cache keys. Looks like cached KV or header leak rather than plain text PII — still high severity. recommended immediate mitigations:
- isolate Omega's dedicated pool from global prefix routing
- force-evict KV caches on affected hosts
- rollback routing-policy to v2.2 if safe
- kick a canary restart of router process on dedicated nodes
Priya (eng-runtime): agree. runbook: routing-rollbacks/runbook.md (internal). quick commands:
```
# isolate pool
redwoodctl routing policy set --customer-id=omega --mode=isolate
# evict kv cache on nodes in pool-omega
kubectl -n inference exec -it router-pod-<id> -- sh -c "redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 del \"kv:omega:*\""
# rollout rollback
redwoodctl rollout routing-policy --version=v2.2 --target=dedicated
```
Nina (security): please snapshot the affected hosts and preserve logs before any cache flushes for forensic. Create an E-Discovery snapshot and note chain-of-custody. We should run queries for accessed keys: `SELECT * FROM access_logs WHERE dest_pool='pool-zeus' AND key LIKE 'omega:%'` and preserve results.
Samira (on-call): good point. Jun, can you snapshot and upload to secure bucket before evict?
Jun (SRE): snapshotting now. uploading to s3://redwood-incidents/1968527777/ (iam restricted). Will share link when done. Starting cache eviction on 3 of 4 affected hosts in staging first.
Liam (acct-exec): loop me in on customer comms. Omega security team is online; they need an initial status update within 15 minutes. Draft that we are investigating potential cross-tenant KV cache exposure, no confirmed PII leak yet, containment actions underway.
Ravi (CS): drafting: "We detected anomalous routing that may have caused cached entries to be served from an incorrect tenant pool. We're isolating the pool, evicting caches, and will provide a follow-up within 60 minutes. No evidence of broad data exfiltration at this time." sending to Liam for review.
Jun (SRE): snapshot complete: s3://redwood-incidents/1968527777/snap-logs.tar.gz (restricted). Starting evict on host-a, host-b. Host-c showing elevated CPU -> throttling eviction, pausing.
Priya (eng-runtime): host-c may be under load due to batch workloads. switch eviction to sequential, not parallel. Also set routing fallback to strict-match mode:
```
redwoodctl config set routing.strict_match=true --target=dedicated
```
Samira (on-call): executing strict-match now. applying to Omega's pool only.
incident-bot: Action logged: strict-match applied to customer=omega by Samira. Incident link: https://redwood/incidents/1968527777
Nina (security): ran forensic query on the snapshot. Found ~98 keys with omega: prefix served from pool-zeus between 01:12:05 and 01:18:32 UTC. Sample (sanitized):
```
access_log: request_id=abc123 tenant=omega dest_pool=pool-zeus key=omega:patient-xxxx action=read
```
Nina (security): severity assessment: medium-high. Some keys map to hashed patient IDs — need to confirm if those are reversible. Eng/Prod please hold evictions minimal until we confirm redaction risk.
Priya (eng-runtime): we can redact cache entries instead of full eviction: replace values with null markers while preserving key metadata. Command snippet:
```
for k in $(redis-cli KEYS 'kv:omega:*'); do redis-cli SET $k '__REDACTED__'; done
```
Jun (SRE): careful with KEYS on prod. use SCAN. executing a safe scrub against one host now.
Samira (on-call): customer update ready? Liam?
Liam (acct-exec): sending initial note: "We've isolated your dedicated pool and are mitigating cached entries. We have collected logs for investigation and will follow up with findings and any recommendations. No confirmed data leak affecting other customers beyond limited cached reads; we will provide more detail soon." Sent.
Ravi (CS): Omega replied: they want timeline and confirmation that backups are unaffected. Asking for hourly updates.
Priya (eng-runtime): short-term mitigations done: strict-match enabled, sequential scrub started, routing-policy rollback scheduled (10 min). Will monitor error rates.
Jun (SRE): scrub complete on host-a/host-b. host-c scrub paused for manual review due to CPU. No further cross-tenant reads observed after strict-match applied. Monitoring window 20m.
Nina (security): we ran reversed-hash check on sampled keys. No reversible PII found in samples. Still prepping formal incident classification and escalation if needed.
Samira (on-call): handoff: I'm staying on lead until we finish 60m monitoring. If anyone needs to escalate, ping @Samira. Jun, please own postmortem and RCA timeline.
Jun (SRE): will own postmortem. initial RCA hypothesis: regression in prefix prioritization logic in routing-policy v2.3 + stale route TTLs on dedicated routing caches. Action items:
- revert v2.3 changelist affecting prefix ordering (PR #4826)
- add stricter unit/integration tests for overlapping prefixes
- add autoscrub for cache entries on policy change
- customer outreach template for cross-tenant cache events
Samira (on-call): status update to channel: containment achieved, mitigations applied, customer notified. Monitoring. Will update when we hit end of 60m window or if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> status: mitigated (containment). timeline and evidence archived under ticket INC-1968527777
Samira (on-call): thanks team. Jun, please include proposed timeline for rollback and the postmortem draft. Closing thread in 1h if stable.
Liam (acct-exec): sending follow-up to Omega with preserved logs link and next steps. They acknowledged receipt and asked for tech contact (Ravi -> provided). :thumbsup:
Ravi (CS): Omega wants confirmation when the dedicated pool is fully cleared. Will push that once Jun confirms scrub complete across all hosts.
Jun (SRE): scrub completed across all hosts at last check. final verification run shows zero keys matching 'kv:omega:*' with content referencing pool-zeus. marking as contained.
Samira (on-call): closing note: incident contained, customer notified, postmortem assigned to Jun, security review by Nina. Thanks all.
